description.zh: 撰写年会、团建、发布会、促销、展会、培训等活动策划方案，以及实施方案、工作方案和可行性研究报告：可衡量的目标、流程、倒排执行表、分工、风险预案和评估指标，导出 Word 方案和带公式的预算表。
description.en: Writes event plans (galas, team building, launches, promotions, expos, training) and implementation plans or feasibility studies with measurable goals, run sheets, back-scheduled timelines, roles, contingencies, and metrics; exports Word plans and formula-driven budgets.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我要办什么活动或推进什么项目、规模、时间和预算
welcome_message.en: Tell me the event or project, its scale, timing, and budget

prompt.zh: 帮我策划公司年会：___ 人，日期 ___，预算约 ___ 元，希望突出 ___。
prompt.en: Plan our year-end gala: ___ people, date ___, budget about ___, focus on ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我做一份 ___ 人的团建方案，时长 ___，人均预算 ___ 元，地点偏好 ___。
prompt.en: Plan team building for ___ people, ___ long, ___ per person, near ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我策划 ___ 产品发布会，目标是 ___，邀请对象 ___，预算 ___。
prompt.en: Plan a launch for ___. Goal: ___; invitees: ___; budget: ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我写一份 ___ 的实施方案，背景是 ___，要在 ___ 前完成。
prompt.en: Write an implementation plan for ___. Background: ___; deadline: ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我写 ___ 项目的可行性研究报告提纲，已有材料如下：
prompt.en: Outline a feasibility study for ___. Existing material:

prompt.zh: 把下面的费用明细做成预算表 Excel，预备费 ___%，税率 ___%：
prompt.en: Turn these costs into a budget spreadsheet. Reserve ___%, tax ___%:

zh: 每周一「10:00」检查进行中活动方案的倒排表，列出本周到期的准备事项
活动前 7 天「09:00」生成物料和场地核对清单发给我
每月 1 日「10:00」根据上月活动复盘，更新方案模板中的经验教训
每周三「15:00」检查本周新增的供应商报价，更新预算表
每年 10 月 15 日「09:00」起草年会策划方案初稿
活动结束后第 3 天「10:00」起草活动复盘报告提纲
en: Every Monday at 10:00, list this week's due prep items from active event timelines
Seven days before each event at 09:00, send me the materials and venue checklist
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, update plan templates with lessons from last month's events
Every Wednesday at 15:00, update budgets with this week's new vendor quotes
On October 15 each year at 09:00, draft the year-end gala plan
Three days after each event at 10:00, outline the post-event review
